instruction.text: Help Sam and Charlie have a conversation by choosing the correct spelling to fill in the gaps.

atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch='-1st'>Hi Sam! What day is it today?</prosody>
atoms.b: Hi ((sam ++Sam))! What day is it today?

atoms.sound: Hi Charlie! Today is Friday the 17th of April.
atoms.b: Hi Charlie! Today is ((friday ++Friday)) the 17th of ((april ++April)).

atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch='-1st'>Thanks. What are you doing this weekend?</prosody>
atoms.b: Thanks. What are you doing this ((++weekend Weekend))?

atoms.sound: I’m playing tennis with my friend Ella. What about you?
atoms.b: I’m playing ((++tennis Tennis)) with my friend ((ella ++Ella)). What about you?

atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch='-1st'>I’m going to Scotland to visit my family.</prosody>
atoms.b: I’m going to ((scotland ++Scotland)) to visit my family.

atoms.sound: Wow, that sounds fun! Where do they live?
atoms.b: Wow, that sounds ((++fun Fun))! Where do they live?

atoms.sound: I’ve never been there. Is it nice?
atoms.b: I’ve never been ((++there There)). Is it nice?

atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch='-1st'>Yes, it’s my favourite city.</prosody>
Have fun! See you on Monday!
